Independent current Definition review: The function selects an element of every member of a nonempty-member family; the empty family admits the empty function. Choice on X is choice for its nonempty subsets, including X empty. Inline function, power-set and set-difference links interrupt the Definition. This is presentation debt, not a failure of the AC interface. Independent current Definition review: The normal law is the affine pushforward of the normalized Gaussian measure, assumes AC, and gives the Dirac mass when sigma=0. Supplier titles remain ungrammatical sentence fragments. The example needs only variance-one translates: the common independent-standard-normal coupling cancels (1,-1,-1) in both path sums, proving equality of the entire joint law.
